triage.root_cause: The temp file gets 0o600 permissions via os.fchmod(), but after os.replace() the final file may not retain these permissions on all filesystems/platforms. The code implicitly relies on os.replace() preserving permissions, which is not guaranteed.
risk_points: Final db file may be world-readable on some systems
Other users on multi-user systems could read sensitive todo data
triage.proposed_fix: Explicitly call os.chmod(self.path, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR) after os.replace() to ensure the final file has 0o600 permissions
